description: This file defines the 'FieldViewer' class responsible for rendering dynamic form fields based on their type within the SuiteCRM extension. It contains methods for generating the appropriate HTML templates and handles various field types, including address, bool, int, float, date, enum, relate, text, and custom types via external template files.

classes.name: FieldViewer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering form layouts for dynamic fields based on their type, utilizing Smarty templates and external PHP files for specialized input types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FieldViewer instance by creating a new Sugar_Smarty object.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Generates HTML layout for a given field definition, loading the appropriate template based on the field's 'type'. Handles various predefined types and defaults to loading a PHP template if available, or a varchar template otherwise.
